purpose: Shortlist real architectural accent heads whose controlled supplier/lab photometry can replace the current conceptual V5.2 light field.
preferredFamilyStrategy: Prefer one manufacturer family that offers interchangeable or sibling narrow, spot and flood optics so the canopy uses one visual/electrical language.

lightQuality.notes: 2700K may remain a future option, but the first controlled photometry package should use one exact 3000K configuration.

physicalTargets.finish: dark bronze, dark champagne, black, or custom finish compatible with canopy

mandatoryResearchReturns: official IES or LDT photometry file
photometry file URL or download source
notes on custom finish or OEM/private-label availability
rejectionRules: Do not accept a generic family page without the exact optic/LED configuration.
Do not treat a marketing beam angle as a substitute for an IES/LDT file.
Do not fabricate IES data from screenshots, lumen claims, or the current Three.js viewer.
Do not mix photometry from one wattage/CCT/optic with a different product configuration.
Do not shortlist a head if official photometry cannot be obtained unless it is clearly marked research-only.
